memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Moses summoned all Israel and said: Hear, Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them and be sure to follow them. The Lord our God made a covenant with us at Horeb. It was not with our ancestors that the Lord made this covenant, but with us, with all of us who are alive here today. - Deut 5:1-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
A new generation had grown up in the wilderness. Their parents had stood at Mount Horeb (Sinai) and heard God speak, but most of them had died in the desert. So Moses gathers the children and grandchildren and says something striking: this covenant is with us — with you who are alive today. He was not denying history. He was saying that God's covenant was not a dusty family heirloom belonging only to the past. It was living, personal, and present for each new generation that would receive it by faith.

There is a gentle warning here for all of us. Faith is never inherited automatically. Your grandmother's prayers, your family's Christian heritage, the church you grew up in — these are precious gifts, but they cannot save you. Each of us must personally hear God's Word, learn it, and follow it. God has no grandchildren; He only has children.

Under the New Covenant, we too are invited to say "us" and "today." The same God who spoke at Horeb speaks now through His Son (Heb 1:1-2). His Word is not a relic to admire but a living voice to obey. Do not lean on someone else's walk with God. Make it your own, today.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Have I made faith in God personal, or am I resting on my family's Christianity?
- What does it mean that God's Word is "for us, today" and not just history?
- Am I learning God's ways in order to follow them, or only to know about them?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that Your covenant love is not locked in the past but reaches me personally today. Help me not to lean on the faith of others, but to hear Your voice and walk with You myself. Amen.
